description: A React component implementing a file editor panel within a project workspace. It manages file listing, creating, editing, and deleting, and provides a minimal inline diff view to compare changes.

methods.name: refresh
methods.description: Fetches the latest list of project files and updates the component state accordingly.

methods.name: selectFile
methods.description: Selects a file from the list and loads its content into the editor.

methods.name: createNew
methods.description: Creates a new file with a user-specified path and refreshes the file list.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves current content and path changes of the selected file.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Deletes the currently selected file after user confirmation.

methods.name: simpleDiff
methods.description: Generates a simple line-by-line diff string between two text contents.
